method: Hand-authored SVG committed to this repository
purpose: A cover of last resort for every homepage record kind, so a record is never dropped from the page for want of a picture and no image is ever passed off as source material.
rules: None of these is a photograph, a reconstruction, or evidence of anything.
Each carries a caption saying what it is; the caption is not optional chrome.
The testimony and documentation covers are safe covers: they may never depict, quote or reconstruct the record they stand in front of.
The portrait cover leaves the oval empty. Where no photograph of a person is cleared, none is invented.

assets.drawn: Abstract broadsheet: a measured masthead rule, three receding columns, one gold datum line.
One claim at the left repeated outward through a network; a single traced thread carried across.
Filed cards on a working board joined by an analyst's thread.
An empty chair beside an open, lit doorway, and a voice given as measure only.
A stacked archive folder under a seal, contents concealed.
A portrait mount with the oval left open and the name rule beneath it empty.
Layered strata cut by one vertical reading line.
